cells.partition: axis cells: each row in the cell of argmax_k <v, a_hat_k>, a_hat_k = a_k / ||a_k|| in binary64, ties to the lower axis index (the Z script's attractor); median_c is null for a cell of fewer than two rows

nearest_neighbours.definition: nearest neighbour: the other row at the smallest distance of pairwise_distances, ties to the lower row index; with distinct distances the edge to it is an edge of the minimum spanning tree, and outside_tree counts the notes whose nearest-neighbour edge is not

relational_distances.definition: relational distance: shortest path along the relations, each weighted by its unrounded L2 distance; defined only within a connected component (infinite, never written, between components); hops: fewest relations on a path, reported as context only

relations.manual: absent: manual relations exist only in an engine database, not in the frozen artefact
relations.source: union, on unordered row pairs, of the within-cell relations (the pairs of one axis cell whose binary64 L2 distance of pairwise_distances is <= that cell's median_c, numpy.median of the edge weights of the minimum spanning tree of the cell's rows) and every edge of the minimum spanning tree (Prim, from row 0, ties to the lower row index) of the complete graph over the binary64 L2 distances of pairwise_distances; a pair appears once, weighted by its distance of pairwise_distances

statement: Descriptive exploration of the relation graph: it tests no hypothesis and decides nothing.
